scope: 49 statewide Eventbrite result pages; public in-person Utah events only

methodology.discovery: Crawled Eventbrite public statewide search results and retained structured event, venue, schedule, tag and image metadata.
methodology.ranking: Holiday and seasonal relevance, public experience, cultural/community value, performance, family/adult fit and Salt Lake proximity raise review priority; online, business and professional-training listings are suppressed.
methodology.publicationRule: Discovery score never confirms an event. Each selected listing must be opened and verified for current schedule, full ticket price, age limit, accessibility, organizer language and image suitability before publication.
